workingTitle: 跨资产协同感知语义契约图与差分执行
scope: Build a cooperative-perception-specific contract intermediate representation that links paper claims, release manifests, converters, configuration, loaders, checkpoints, and evaluators, then tests semantic invariants through structure-aware linting and differential execution.

verifiedContractDrifts.finding: CRC-verified released mini indexes contain four ego projections and metainfo.dataset=OPV2V, while every public converter version and the paper protocol define three vehicle ego projections and the current converter writes metainfo.dataset=CooperScene.
verifiedContractDrifts.claimBoundary: This does not identify which index produced a paper table or establish any metric effect.

verifiedContractDrifts.finding: The paper describes an 80/20 sequence split, while two fixed public configurations list identical train and test scenario sets and the loader selects those lists directly.
verifiedContractDrifts.claimBoundary: Without authorized data enumeration, call this a static paper-versus-public-configuration protocol drift, not proven sample leakage or paper-result contamination.

verifiedContractDrifts.finding: The fixed public producer writes other_fut_* keys while the training loader requires other_label, other_auxiliary_label, and other_label_mask, alongside independently audited entrypoint and mode inconsistencies.
verifiedContractDrifts.claimBoundary: No released checkpoint or intermediate artifact establishes that an internal unpublished pipeline had the same mismatch.

verifiedContractDrifts.finding: The fixed public path exposes a selected-cell proxy but no complete executable framing and byte-accounting path, while the paper reports communication volume and transmitted integer codes.
verifiedContractDrifts.claimBoundary: The public artifact cannot independently verify proxy-to-wire-byte equivalence; this does not establish that the paper's communication values are wrong.

nearestWorkBoundary.occupiedSpace: Types, required fields, and local structural constraints.
Deriving runtime semantic checkers from tests; test-to-checker is not a contribution here.
Sensor corruption and temporal-misalignment robustness, not cross-artifact release semantics.

noveltyBoundary: The research object is a cross-asset provenance graph, not one repository's bug list.

The invariant vocabulary is cooperative-perception-specific: ego and agent roles, transform direction, clock domain, agent order, physical-event identity, cohort, payload identity, and proxy-versus-wire communication units.
The validation method combines structure-aware extraction with semantic-preserving metamorphic transforms and paired differential execution.
Every violation carries an evidence boundary that separates static contract drift, runtime behavior, and unidentified metric impact.
twoWeekMinimum: Freeze four official commits and construct a read-only artifact graph spanning paper claim, YAML, converter, release index, loader, checkpoint metadata, and evaluator.
Parse Python AST, YAML, restricted pickle manifests, and state_dict key and shape metadata without regex-based binary interpretation.

Run four CPU-first differentials: CooperScene release versus converter; V2XScenes train versus test selectors; Co-MTP producer versus consumer key sets; CodeFilling proxy rate versus a reference serialization boundary.
Inject paired semantic mutants for ego role, transform direction, unit, agent order, timestamp provenance, physical-event cohort, and checkpoint-config binding.
Emit a machine-readable violation ledger with commit, path, observed value, expected invariant, minimum counterexample, and claim boundary.
sixWeekStudy: Add read-only instrumentation at loader, packer, fusion, and evaluator boundaries for ego, agent lineage, frame, age, payload identity, and cohort.
On one license-compatible runnable stack, freeze a model or train a clearly labeled lightweight baseline and compare original, normalized, and injected-fault paired replay.
Port the shared rules to two additional frameworks and measure shared-rule coverage, repository-specific rules, false positives, localization, and overhead.
Release the contract schema, mutant corpus, paired outputs, provenance ledger, license inventory, and reproducible commands.

falsifiableClaims.claim: One shared contract IR detects the verified drift classes across at least three independent frameworks.
falsifiableClaims.falsifier: Rules reduce to repository names and fixed key special cases, or structural schema baselines detect the same complete set.

falsifiableClaims.claim: At least one structurally valid contract drift changes evaluator cohort or a frozen model output before an exception is raised.
falsifiableClaims.falsifier: Every tested drift is explicitly rejected by the original implementation or no paired output difference is observable.

falsifiableClaims.claim: Semantic-preserving normalization is stable under agent permutation, frame round trip, and unit-preserving transformations.
falsifiableClaims.falsifier: Clean legal transformations produce unexplained output differences beyond preregistered numeric tolerances.

baselines: JSON Schema or Pydantic structural validation
metrics: Detection lead time before model or evaluator failure
Per-frame latency and peak memory overhead
killCriteria: Fewer than three independently verified cross-asset instances survive primary-source rechecking.
The shared IR degenerates into repository-specific key lists.
Every target drift is already caught by an original assertion or a structural schema baseline.
No licensed runnable model path exists by the end of the metadata prototype; drop model-impact claims.
Actual serialized payload boundaries remain unavailable; drop proxy-to-wire communication claims.
assetBoundary: CooperScene code is MIT and the mini release has an official checksum and manifest; data derivatives remain under the official CC BY-NC-SA terms.
V2XScenes requires authorized data access and has no verified commit-bound paper checkpoint.
Co-MTP and V2X-Seq lack a verified public checkpoint and clear redistribution contract in the audited assets.
CodeFilling license metadata is inconsistent; use the stricter repository license and restrict the first prototype to parser and tensor semantics.
